questions.question: How long does a typical AI project take?
questions.answer: Project timelines vary based on complexity. A proof-of-concept can be delivered in 4-6 weeks, while full production implementations typically take 3-6 months. We'll provide a detailed timeline during our initial consultation.

questions.question: Do we need a large dataset to get started with AI?
questions.answer: Not necessarily. While more data generally leads to better results, we can work with smaller datasets and use techniques like transfer learning to achieve meaningful results. We'll assess your data situation and recommend the best approach.

questions.question: How do you ensure AI solutions are ethical and unbiased?
questions.answer: Ethics is central to our approach. We conduct bias audits, implement fairness metrics, and ensure transparency in how AI decisions are made. We also provide documentation and training so your team understands how the AI works.

questions.question: What ongoing support do you provide?
questions.answer: We offer flexible support packages including monitoring, maintenance, model retraining, and continuous optimization. Our goal is to ensure your AI solutions deliver lasting value, not just initial results.
